scope: http_transport translates actual urllib HTTPError responses to QlooError
expectations: For actual localhost HTTP 401, 429 and 503 responses, both the HTTPError wrapper and its underlying response must already be closed when QlooError construction begins and when it escapes.
Error response bodies must remain unread; body and header sentinel text must never enter the translated diagnostic.
The existing QlooError status, retryable property, exact status/reason diagnostic, suppressed cause and absence of retry are preserved.

The actual GET preserves the requested path, percent-decoded dotted query parameters, zero and False values, filters only None and empty strings, and preserves the supplied synthetic fixture headers and explicit timeout.
A successful HTTP 200 response returns the same decoded JSON and closes its response through the existing context manager.
Each invocation sends exactly one request. Tests use no provider, actual credential, installation or external network. Source bytes remain unchanged.
method: Use an actual ThreadingHTTPServer and the real urllib opener. A scoped urlopen wrapper retains actual error/response objects and observes reads; a QlooError subclass records close state at construction without changing original error semantics. Keep references alive until assertions, then close fixture objects.
